material.locator: World Bank, “The Future of Food: Shaping the Food System to Deliver Jobs”, “Story Highlights” and “Main Messages”, passages on off-farm value-chain segments and services.
material.description: The World Bank publication describes activities beyond primary production, including storage, processing, distribution, transport, logistics and retailing. The claim is limited to the listed off-farm functions and does not imply equal importance in every food system.
